IMPORTANT CAVEAT, scored optimistically and flagged for Katie's judgment: this is posted as a CCO role, not a counsel role. The listing asks for Series 65 / CFA / CAMS-type certifications and audit experience, which Katie may not hold. It is scored 50/50 on fit because the underlying work — fund structure, SEC/FINRA registration, side-letter-adjacent fund documentation, governance, policies — is squarely her ICP, not because she is a literal match for the CCO title. PITCH ANGLE: do not apply as a compliance officer. Approach as fund counsel who can own the legal and regulatory build for a Fund I launch (entity and fund structure, registration mechanics, LPA/PPM/subscription document review, governance and policy drafting), and either (a) propose a scoped counsel engagement alongside a credentialed CCO, or (b) ask whether they would split the mandate. Emerging managers frequently post one blended role because they do not yet know they need two. Even if this specific engagement is not the fit, the firm is a high-value relationship target — a first-time fund founded by non-finance operators is the ideal fractional fund-counsel client. ACTION: verify the posting is still live, then apply via Go Fractional with a scoped-counsel reframe rather than a straight application.
